notes: Search is a place now: type a few letters for suggestions, land on a results page you can back out of, and see the shop's own picks when nothing matches
"Based on your size" is a shelf you browse: a poster sized to what fits you, ten pairs, and a See more card that opens the whole list
"On Sale" opens on a poster showing the biggest live discount, and tapping it lists everything on sale
Both shelves now search, filter and sort where you stand — no trip back to the feed to change your mind
Shop by audience: Men's, Women's, Kids' and Unisex shelves in the Home category row
Product cards page through a seller's photos by swiping, without leaving the feed
The Artisan Catalog is now The Workshop Collection, and its name is a card you can flip to pick the order — the feed no longer opens a sheet
Cards answer your touch: they sink under a press and sit on a real drop shadow, on a tighter corner
Dark mode, with a control in Settings
Size Your Foot takes manual entry with your own scale, plus US and UK labels
Sellers: say who a product is for, and the audience shelves fill themselves
Sellers: the performance dashboard switches tabs instantly
Fixed: a sale card's price no longer leaves a gap under it
Best Sellers: the home rail is switched off for now — the filter still works
